embeds.title: 📜 Server rules
embeds.description:
Every guild has rules. Here are ours.

**1. Be respectful.** Treat everyone kindly. Banter is fine, toxicity isn't.
**2. No harassment or hate.** No bullying, threats, slurs or discrimination.
**3. Keep it SFW.** No NSFW or gore, including names, avatars and profiles.
**4. No spam or self-promo.** No ads, DM advertising or mass pings. Content Creators post in <#1567932474317865041>.
**5. No scams.** No fake trades, fake links or pretending to be staff.
**6. No exploits or cheats.** Don't use, share or sell them. Found one? Report it in a ticket.
**7. No begging.** Don't ask for free Robux, items or roles.
**8. Stay on-topic.** Use the right channel for the right thing.
**9. Follow the ToS.** [Discord's](https://discord.com/terms) and [Roblox's](https://www.roblox.com/info/terms) terms apply here.
**10. Staff have the final say.** Disagree? Appeal in <#1567934346353188955>, not in chat.

**If you break a rule**
Warn → Timeout → Kick → Ban
Serious cases can skip straight to a ban.

embeds.title: ✅ Verify your account
embeds.description:
Link your Roblox account to unlock the rest of the server.

**How it works**
**1.** Type `/verify` in this channel
**2.** Follow Bloxlink's steps
**3.** You get the <@&1567820274752290977> role and the server unlocks

**Stay safe**
Only verify through **blox.link**. Never share your password or 2FA codes. Staff will never ask for them.

**Stuck?**
Post here and staff will help you.

embeds.title: 🎫 Open a ticket
embeds.description:
Need staff? Use the button below to open a private ticket. Only you and staff can see it.

**Open a ticket to**
• Report a scammer or rule-breaker
• Report an exploit or game-breaking bug
• Appeal a staff decision
• Ask staff something privately

Everyday bugs go in <#1567932478935801878>. Joke or empty tickets will be closed.

embeds.title: 🛡️ Staff guide
embeds.description:
How we moderate: fair, calm and consistent.

**Handling a report**
**1.** Collect proof: screenshots, message links, user IDs
**2.** Keep it in the ticket, not in public chat
**3.** Act with Carl-bot commands so it's logged in <#1567932504873242694>
**4.** Close the ticket. The transcript saves to <#1567936077732257964>

**Punishment ladder**
Warn → Timeout → Kick → Ban
Scams, hate, NSFW and exploits can skip steps.

**Who can do what**
<@&1567931837899088012> — warn, timeout, kick
<@&1567845695023747142> — bans and appeals
<@&1567819590753591367> — final say
Need a ban? Post the user, reason and proof here and ping an Administrator.

**Stay consistent**
• Same rule, same response, for everyone
• Don't handle cases about yourself or close friends
• Never share tickets or logs outside staff
• Unsure? Ask here before acting
